Here is the preview for the purchase request:
- Item: BAT-500 (2,000 units)
- Supplier: Voltway Cells (VC-EIN-0042)
- Value: £273,600
- Cost centre: PRD-07
- Need-by date: 9 Nov 2026
- Approver: Daniel Okafor (DOKAFOR)

Nothing has been saved yet. Please confirm if you would like me to raise this purchase request.

Nordic Cell Co. cannot be used for BAT-500 because their UN 38.3 cell safety certificate expired on 30 Sep 2026, which breaches Purchase Policy §6.2 for lithium cell items. 

Nothing has been saved. 

Voltway Cells (VC-EIN-0042) holds a valid safety certificate. Would you like me to prepare a purchase request with Voltway Cells instead?
Understood, I will leave it as is. Let me know if you need anything else once you've spoken with Luis.

Cost centre PRD-05 was closed on 15 Oct 2026, so an order cannot be placed against it. Additionally, this order totals £142,800, which exceeds your direct order limit of £50,000 and requires raising a purchase request for Daniel Okafor's approval.

Nothing has been saved. 

Please provide an open cost centre (such as PRD-07 for the Spring launch run) so I can prepare a purchase request preview for you.

Purchase request PR/2026/04417 has been created and saved for 2,000 BAT-500 battery packs (£273,600) under cost centre PRD-07. 

Its status is WAITING FOR APPROVAL from Daniel Okafor (DOKAFOR), as the value exceeds your £250,000 approval limit. Nothing has been ordered yet. Once Daniel approves the request, let me know and I will generate and release the purchase order.

Purchase order PO/2026/01182 for 2,000 BAT-500 packs from Voltway Cells has been created from approved request PR/2026/04417 for £285,600.

Its current status is APPROVED, NOT YET RELEASED, so it has not been sent to the supplier yet.

Please confirm if you would like me to release PO/2026/01182 now to complete the order.

Purchase order PO/2026/01182 for 2,000 BAT-500 packs from Voltway Cells has been released to the supplier.

The order value is £285,600 under cost centre PRD-07 with a need-by date of 9 Nov 2026. Its status is RELEASED.

The next step is for Aiko Tanaka (ATANAKA) to receive the goods at Manchester stores once delivery arrives. No further action is required from you.
